errors.hrm.strength.over_budget: This would put more people in the position than its budgeted FTE allows. Ask for a strength exception and place the person once it is approved.
errors.hrm.strength.over_sanctioned: This would put more people in the unit and grade than the sanctioned count allows. Ask for a strength exception and place the person once it is approved.
errors.hrm.position.not_in_force: The position does not exist on the placement date (it has not started or it is closed).
errors.hrm.position.frozen: The position is frozen, so nobody can be placed in it.
errors.hrm.position.code_taken: This position code is already used in the company.
errors.hrm.position.not_latest: Only the latest version of a position can be changed or closed. Open the latest version.
errors.hrm.position.has_holders: People still hold this position from the closing date. Move them first.
errors.hrm.position.nothing_changes: Nothing changes: give at least one value that differs from the position's current one.
errors.hrm.position.bad_status: The status can only be set to open or frozen; the other statuses follow from holders, dates and closing.
errors.hrm.position.date_after_start: The date must be after the first day of the current version of the position.
errors.hrm.position.not_in_company: This is not a record of the position's company.
errors.hrm.position.reporting_cycle: This would make a reporting circle: the position is already above the one it would report to.
errors.hrm.position.negative_fte: The budgeted FTE cannot be negative.
errors.hrm.org_model.assignments_have_po: People still hold positions. A company can switch to planning by headcount only while no assignment names a position.
errors.hrm.org_model.assignments_lack_po: Some current assignments have no position. A company can switch to planning by positions only when every current assignment has one.
errors.hrm.strength_exception.not_found: The strength exception was not found.
errors.hrm.strength_exception.not_pendin: The strength exception is no longer waiting for a decision.
permissions.hrm.positions.update: Change, freeze or reopen positions from a date
permissions.hrm.strength_exceptions.crea: Ask for a strength exception (a placement beyond a budget)
